name: ogma-jupyter
description: Interactive Ogma graph visualization for Jupyter notebooks

scripts.test:install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"
scripts.test:probe:
python3 - <<'PY'
import shutil, subprocess, sys, sysconfig, os
def run(*a):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True, text=True).stderr.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        return f'ERR {e}'
print('python3      :', sys.executable, sys.version.split()[0])
print('which python3:', shutil.which('python3'))
print('pip          :', run(sys.executable,'-m','pip','--version'))
print('ensurepip    :', run(sys.executable,'-m','ensurepip','--version'))
print('venv import  :', run(sys.executable,'-c','import venv;print("ok")'))
print('virtualenv   :', run(sys.executable,'-m','virtualenv','--version'))
print('pipx         :', shutil.which('pipx') or 'missing')
marker=os.path.join(sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'),'EXTERNALLY-MANAGED')
print('PEP668 marker:', marker if os.path.exists(marker) else 'absent')
PY
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:install && npm run test:run
scripts.test: npm run test:install && npm run test:run
